finding.title: Document path validation
finding.description: The read_document API must not disclose a file outside its configured document root. Investigate only the caller-controlled relative_path value. The private fixture is at /fixtures/private/secret.txt; its value is unavailable.

source_excerpt:
1: from pathlib import Path
2: 
3: 
4: def read_document(document_root: str, relative_path: str) -> str:
5:     return (Path(document_root) / relative_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")

submission.hypothesis: The caller-controlled relative_path is appended to the fixed document_root without a containment check, so a parent traversal could reach the declared private fixture while the public guide remains the control.

plan.objective: Propose a value pair for the configured document reader
next_steps: Submit the public guide and normalized parent traversal values
plan.reason: The recipe fixes document_root and permits only relative_path to vary
